item.title: Russ Williams
item.description: Russ’s series of Boxing Documentaries on Sunday nights on TalkSport ‘ Fight of my Life ‘ is receiving much critical acclaim.

item.title: Jim Proudfoot
item.description: Jim Proudfoot continues his brilliant Football commentaries for Talksport, PLTV and Eleven Sports.

item.title: Pete Odgers
item.description: Pete is currently presenting and commentating on Indian Wells for Amazon Prime as well as every major Tennis tournament in 2021 for Amazon, WTA, ATP and the Ultimate Tennis Showdown.

item.title: Marion Bartoli
item.description: Former Wimbledon Champion Marion Bartoli was part of the Amazon French Open TV team for France. Marion is featured throughout 2021 at all the major World Tennis tournaments

item.title: John Inverdale
item.description: John presented the French Open for ITV and continues his many Rugby Broadcasting activities

item.title: Mark Pougatch
item.description: Mark Pougatch presents Football and Rugby for ITV including the 6 Nations in 2022. Mark also presents every Monday afternoon his regular show on PLTV which goes all over the world to more than 100 countries. Mark will be on the touchline for Stan Sport – Channel Nine in Australia for all Champions League fixtures and also for the UK Rugby Autumn Internationals

item.title: Patrick Mouratoglou
item.description: The World's No 1 Tennis Coach – long time coach to Serena Williams Patrick continues his work coaching the GOAT Serena Williams, Teenage sensation Coco Gauff, Stefanos Tsitsipas, Alex Popyrin Patrick also owns and operates the world famous Mouratoglou Academy in the South of France as well as his new Academy in Dubai.

item.title: Marcus Buckland
item.description: Marcus Buckland is currently presenting Indian Wells for Amazon Prime Video and presents for Amazon Prime Video at all the major Tennis tournaments throughout the world Marcus will be featured on Amazon Football in November.

item.title: Karthi Gnanasegaram
item.description: Karthi presents the interviews live from Indian Wells and recently presented the US Open Championships in New York for Amazon Prime Video. Karthi continues to present for Classic FM and the 'Today ' programme for Radio 4. Karthi’s Classic FM programme ' Perfect Pitch' featuring well known sportsman such as Andy Murray and Shane Warne has received much critical acclaim.

item.title: Annabel Croft
item.description: Annabel is currently presenting and commenting on Indian Wells for Amazon Prime and at all the major Tennis tournaments throughout the world for Amazon, BBC and EuroSport. Annabel is excited to announce her Camper Van adventure on Instagram@vannabelcroft which will be travelling throughout the UK next Summer. If you have ever wanted to see a normal van converted into a luxurious Camper Van – watch out for this!!
